title: a16z Podcast: The Role of Academia in the Startup World

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Getting denied another round of NSF funding in the early days of Mosaic turned out to be a huge catalyst to start a company around the fledgling web browser..
reader_summary.overview: Getting denied another round of NSF funding in the early days of Mosaic turned out to be a huge catalyst to start a company around the fledgling web browser. Andreessen was still at the University of Illinois at the time. Since Andreessen’s Mosaic days, calibrating the interplay between academia, government, and the private sector has gotten, if not easier.
